content.short: Layer Labs is a pioneering Appchain and Layer 2 Roll-up venture studio.
content.description: Layer Labs is building an Appchain ecosystem by reducing the friction involved in creating Appchains and Layer 2 solutions. It offers guidance on Appchain design, suitable technical stacks, branding, and marketing strategies. Layer Labs also assists with tokenomics, cross-chain liquidity, governance, and fundraising activities. By leveraging partnerships with the OP Collective and the ARB stack, Layer Labs accelerates the development of scalable, decentralized applications for a more open and permissionless economic system.
